import re

    chunk = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 5000)

# Find all tool entries with their calls and results
tool_pattern = re.findall(r'(\[tool \d+\].*?)(?=\[tool \d+\]|\[checkpoint|\[final message|\Z)', full, re.DOTALL)
print(f"Found {len(tool_pattern)} tool blocks")

# Let me also extract just the tool names and parameters
tool_calls = re.findall(r'\[tool (\d+)\] ([\w.]+) (.*?)(?=\[result \1\]|\[result \1\] )', full)
print(f"\nTool calls by number:")
for n, name, params in tool_calls:
    params_short = params[:100].replace('\n', ' ')
    print(f"  tool {n}: {name} {params_short}")

# Check for any repo.write_file or similar write operations
write_ops = [(m.start(), full[m.start():m.start()+300]) for m in re.finditer(r'repo\.write_file|repo\.edit|repo\.create', full)]
print(f"\nWrite operations: {len(write_ops)}")
for pos, snippet in write_ops:
    print(f"  at {pos}: {snippet}")
